messages.author: 3453ccb16a95b830
messages.subject: Extracting country IDs from gridCountriesDegreesHalf
parts:
Dear Andy,

I am trying to extract the country identifier for each half degree from gridCountriesDegreesHalf, but unfortunately with no success. Is there any easy way of creating a data frame with Latitude, Longitude and Country ID columns or something like map.where(database="world", lon, lat) - like in the maps package? This is probably a very trivial question, but I can't seem to get my head around it...

Thank you for the package, it is very helpful!

All the best,

László

messages.author: 81b6b3d7dfea88a5
messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] Extracting country IDs from gridCountriesDegreesHalf
parts:
Hi László,

gridCountriesDegreesHalf is a spatialGridDataFrame defined in the package sp.

Off the top of my head you can do something like this to get the coordinates and values in a dataframe (and it misses out the ocean cells). 
tst3 <- as.data.frame(gridCountriesDegreesHalf)

A quick test seems to show them in the right place.
plot(x=tst3$s1, y=tst3$s2, type='n')
text(x=tst3$s1, y=tst3$s2, labels=tst3$ISO_N3, cex=0.6)

Best wishes,
Andy
